subcommands.name: geo replan-from-acquisition
subcommands.description: Validate one external acquisition receipt against explicit local artifact bytes, atomically publish a separate canon_geo_regional_inventory_advancement.v0 sidecar, and emit a new base-inventory-bound canon_geo_plan.v0 on stdout

safety.notes: reads the immutable base plan, base inventory, original question, capabilities, profile, budget, one REQUEST_ID=RECEIPT.json acquisition satisfaction, explicit local artifacts keyed by receipt local_artifacts[].artifact_id, and optional explicit result digest files. It writes only the requested advancement sidecar by sibling-temp, same-filesystem atomic no-clobber publication after a successful replan, then emits the new plan on stdout. Identical existing bytes are idempotent; any different or non-regular existing target is refused. It refuses unless the receipt is live, COMPLETE, positive, nontruncated, full-region, and backed by usable application/json canon_geo_warehouse_rows.v0 artifacts. It does not acquire data, use the network, mutate the base plan or inventory, infer multi-artifact relations without receipt-native mappings, or treat candidate reach as solver truth.

0.meaning: canonical replanned Geo plan emitted on stdout and the separate inventory-advancement sidecar atomically published

2.meaning: REFUSAL / CLI, input IO, receipt IO, parse, satisfaction, advancement, typed-input identity, replan, or sidecar publication error

subcommands.name: geo materialize-h7-population
subcommands.description: Materialize release-pinned Appendix H.7 accepted-loan rows into a typed population artifact, preserving truth planes, association-plane strata, candidate-release rows, population_scope, and primary 26v2 solver subjects
subcommands.deprecation_note: Measurement-tier compatibility adapter; use scripts/geo_measurements/ and the canon_geo_measurements binary for new H.7 measurements.

safety.notes: reads an offline H.7 row artifact and writes only a typed population artifact to stdout; provenance stays outside solver evidence and acquisition/network access remain outside Canon. FixtureSubset is non-gate proof; the checked fixture is 1+1 subjects. RetainedComplete is a claim a supplied artifact may make only when it carries the archived H.7 multi-BBL contract: 35 non-round plus 14 round unique loan subjects, both pinned 26v1/26v2 candidate releases per subject, 98 release-run rows, matching observed_rows, preserved syntactically validated source hashes, and non-fixture SQL-bound cited receipts. Canon validates source-hash syntax and source/hash-kind identity uniqueness but does not recompute source bytes in this offline materializer. No committed 98-row RetainedComplete artifact exists here. Neither 49 subjects nor 98 rows satisfies the frozen E4 target of 79 genuine cases. LiveComplete is data-driven and requires separate nonzero SQL-bound cited legal-residual receipts for both H.7 planes: truth_plane=non_round_amount_date_legal_borough with purpose=live_non_round_acris_candidate_legal_residual, and truth_plane=round_exact_lender_party with purpose=live_round_lender_acris_candidate_legal_residual. collateral_scope is nyc_filed_collateral_slice, not full national collateral.

2.meaning: REFUSAL / CLI, row IO, parse, release, provenance, denominator, truth-plane, or evidence contract error

subcommands.next_command: extract emitted .population to <POPULATION.json>, then run canon geo evaluate --population <POPULATION.json>
